chronicBlockages.primaryCause: Choked storm silt trap & plastic accumulation
chronicBlockages.supportingEvidence: Heavy plastic entrapment in trash rack; 65% cross-section silt accumulation documented across 7 monsoons.
chronicBlockages.recommendedAction: Deploy high-capacity suction excavator & clear trash racks before high tide.

chronicBlockages.name: Market Lane Gutter Junction #4
chronicBlockages.supportingEvidence: Vegetable waste & illegal stall pavement extensions encroaching over primary stormwater drain.
chronicBlockages.recommendedAction: Coordinate stall clearance & conduct CCTV pipe flushing.

auditTrail.detail: 3 linked citizen photos grouped under BLK-02

chronicBlockages.name: Temple Street Low-Dip Catchbasin
chronicBlockages.primaryCause: Tree roots obstructing underground stormwater pipe
chronicBlockages.supportingEvidence: Endoscopic camera logs confirm extensive Banyan tree root web restricting 500mm RCC pipe throughput.
chronicBlockages.recommendedAction: Deploy hydro-jet mechanical root cutter and sleeve internal liner.

auditTrail.detail: WO-2042 created for mechanical root extraction

chronicBlockages.name: Lake View Road Primary Outfall
chronicBlockages.primaryCause: Tidal silt backflow at lake discharge point
chronicBlockages.supportingEvidence: High sediment accumulation at outfall mouth during spring tides; flap gate hinges partially stuck.
chronicBlockages.recommendedAction: Service mechanical flap gate and dredge outfall silt bar.

workOrders.notes: High capacity suction vehicle deployed. Trash rack debris cleared; 12 MT silt removed to date.
Root cutting equipment scheduled for morning low-traffic window (05:00 - 09:00).
Primary drain cleared under fish market stalls. Field photos uploaded for authority sign-off.
Flap gate sandbar dredged (45 MT). Automatic backflow closure mechanism tested successfully.
